name: omaPOD
author: arikisonfire
description: A podcast app for Omarchy, modelled on AntennaPod: a window that tiles and follows your theme, with inbox, queue, downloads, chapters, statistics and backups, plus a bar widget for playback, speed and sleep timer. Picks up where AntennaPod on your phone stopped, through Nextcloud or gpodder.net.

barWidget.description: Podcast now playing with controls, chapters, speed and sleep timer

schema.label: Show the episode title in the bar
Hide the widget when nothing is loaded
Command that starts omaPOD (empty: the one that came with the widget, or the installed one)
Control socket (leave empty for the default)
